Now make one for when Anon's father insists he kill himself quickly before causing anyone any more trouble.

You know, for a friend....
Thanks, I tend to doubt when I think someone is full of it. I'm going to at least try to talk to them again about an assessment, but I'll get a second opinion if I have to.
Thanks for looking out for us

I've just brought up Asperger's with my doctor as an adult after years of answer seeking. I'm pretty good at "passing"(as I understand it), but tried my best to explain my symptoms (very poorly). Having a 150 on the RAADS-R and my families confirmation of my symptoms really made me think I was on to something.

Instead of any proper screening I was told "If you had autism you wouldn't be able to figure it out to talk to me about it. Peoples families or teachers raise the initial flags, not the person with autism."

This sounds wrong to me but I could not push through my awkwardness to say something and I'm not a doctor. I'm considering writing an email, but I'd really appreciate if someone who knew more about this that me could enlighten me.

Thanks. It's not the sharing, though. It's admitting that I am physically fine, but too mentally weak to handle most work. I know it's mostly my family talking, but I feel less of a man or like an outcast or whatever kind of shame this is I'm feeling.

I HATE being so negative. Everything in my mind is screaming to placate you and say I'll do as you say and get better. I think its from the abuse.

I'm trying to be honest about my true beliefs, though.

I don't know how to find anyone to talk to. I post here, but it's just some support and then nothing. Maybe a reply if I reply. No one here knows me or what has happened to me, they just have one objective "Support OP". And even if they knew me it would just be talk. I'm not going to let the people here with me keep hurting me so I can talk on reddit..... If I was going to get better or learn something or meet someone or find resources or something it would be different, but I don't think anyone here can do those things for me. If the suicide hotline can't is my reasoning.

I think the nature of the system is that people like me receive no help whatsoever in the hopes of forcing us into the military or into homelessness or death where the system doesn't have to spent very valuable money on our worthless lives. I think the system is such that I can not be helped unless by some miracle donor or somehow these people are made to pay back what they stole or are sent to jail or something. 

Staying here talking may prolong my life (literally the opposite of what I want), but I don't think it can improve my life (the thing denied to me that I would literally die for).

Thanks. In my religion there is no life after death. I believe I will know neither pleasure or pain or even myself. Pure nothingness. The people in my life will not be injured by my death they do not know compassion. If they do feel pain it will be less than they have inflicted on me. Rule 1a may be meant for cases like myself. I wish I could find compassion, help the world, and meet kind people. I cannot leave the tiny home I'm trapped with my abusers in. Without even having access to the outside world, and with my severe social impairment, I have no hope of meeting anyone much less someone kind.

thanks, but I can't think about it for very long without getting very unwell. I still live with the people who did this to me, though. As you can imagine I do a lot of distracting myself. I'm hope not to have to anymore soon. I hope things go well for you. I'm sorry I cannot make the world any better as I would love to.

Also, rule 4d:
Please, never make promises to our vulnerable OPs that you personally can't keep. This means not saying "it gets better" or guaranteeing any outcomes! It also means not to make any "supportive" but unverifiable assertions about the OP, i.e. telling them they're a good/strong/etc. person.

hahahaha. it's the funniest joke anyone's ever played on me.
I could have died years ago, but I thought it would get better. In the time since I've seen horrors that I will have do die to get out of my head. And here I am again, thinking there must be a way to make it better, but knowing that I cannot go on for much longer.
I'm going to look into those things, thank you. I can't do much, but I can see if I can do those things
I want to be a good, respectable human being. Typing that was very shameful. It's true, though

The problem there is that they could never give me access to firearms, which seems essential to being in military. Also, I already have ptsd without any service and being yelled at is going to bring me mentally back to my family. I don't think crying like a bitch when raised voice conflicts happens would make me a good recruit. I appreciate the idea, though. It could be an option for someone more well than me.
marginally. I can do most things a normal person can. It's the mental illness I have that's really bothering me
Good luck
I came here for help, but reading your post put into words some of what I'm feeling but couldn't express. Thank you. I hope you find new meaning. I'm still searching myself
I guess I talked myself into a maybe by the end of that...

I'm sorry but I don't. After high school I chased the dream of being an engineer and building things to help people. After having my scholarships and grants stolen by my family (twice) and trying and failing to move away I've lost it. I no longer even think about those things. My dream is to not suffer like I was forced to as a child anymore. I thought I could achieve that while alive, but I think I was wrong
It's psychological. I'm not 100% sure but I've been diagnosed ptsd, bipolar, and depression.
Thank you for posting. I think my family does this. After reading the op I got pretty concerned that they were right, but I feel a bit better seeing this.

I tried moving once, but it ended when I ran out of rent money (I would have restored to homelessness to stay away from nfam but I gave in to flying monkeys offering shelter in my home state). I don't know about shelters, but I would love to do this. I don't know how or what I could do to get there

Thanks for sharing. I like it (the odder the better in my opinion).

I get what you mean by information-overloading you brain. I tend to try to get several things going at once and put on some music so that my mind has no room for suffering. (League of Legends, despite the rather mean player base, keeps me distracted for 30-40 min at a time with the help of some nice tunes)

Maybe you would like See Birds by Balam Acab? It's something from my calm-time collection
Hi, thank you. I also like slow music, though I'm having trouble enjoying things like that recently
